notes.title: Play the demo now!
notes.notes:
The Real-Time Strategy Fest has begun and we launched our demo for you to try!

We would love for you to play the demo while it's live and share your feedback with us through our Steam Discussions. The event ends on Jan 27th so get your playtime in while you can!

Don't forget to wishlist the game so you don't miss out on any news and thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934720/Red_Chaos__The_Strict_Order/
